_comment: COMMITTED G2 dynamic baselines (ticket sim-agent-G2-v2). Measured on this
module's dev machine over the recorded real set (synthetic_openclose) + the
tuned grasp scenarios. Timing is MACHINE-SPECIFIC: re-measure on the target box
and bump deliberately. Env overrides: LOOP_REGRESSION_MARGIN.

loop_rate._role: Two-part gate. (a) absolute: p99 compute < period_us. (b) regression: p99 compute < baseline*(1+margin).
loop_rate._MARGIN_SIGNOFF: PROPOSED regression_margin 0.50 (matches the safety filter's margin; the filter dominates loop compute). Absolute period_us is the hard real-time guarantee independent of this margin.

grasp._role: Stable contact, not ejected/exploded, force <= virtual cap.

latency._role: Loop stable + bounded tracking error at low/target/high latency; no divergence.

tracking_penalty._role: MONITORED: dynamics+latency per-segment error vs G1 kinematic (G1 overall p95 ~0.178).
